statement: This sketch creates a mesmerizing pattern of concentric rings that emanate from the center of the canvas, expanding and contracting in a rhythmic, organic pulse. Using a limited grayscale palette, the rings cycle through varying shades of black, white, and gray, creating a sense of depth and motion. The rings are rendered using pure p5.js drawing functions without any external libraries, relying on the built-in `ellipse()` function to draw each ring. The animation is entirely self-contained, with no user interaction required, as the rings continuously pulse in a synchronized yet slightly offset manner to create a hypnotic visual effect that fills the entire canvas.
